notes: Big one: videos now fill the whole screen (no black bar), play with sound (speaker button on every video, plus a Tap for sound pill when your browser blocks autoplay), and captions sit at the bottom above the nav. Hashtags suggest themselves as you type with post counts. Sounds are reusable now — tap the audio name on any video to reuse it in yours. Comments got threads with replies on replies, creator pins and hearts, edit/delete on your own, long-press reporting with an automatic rules check, and tappable commenter profiles. New in Settings: a Light / Dark theme picker.
